newsitem.title: USA: Sovereign sees Q3 core oper $0.28-$0.29/shr.
newsitem.headline: Sovereign sees Q3 core oper $0.28-$0.29/shr.

text.p: Sovereign Bancorp Inc Chief Executive Jay Sidhu said on Friday that third quarter core operating earnings for the Pennsylvania-based financial company should be about $0.28 to $0.29 per share.
The company said this is consistent with analysts' earnings estimates.
First Call consensus estimates put the company's earnings figure at $0.30 per share.
First Call listed the year-ago earnings at $0.25 per share.

The company said it also expects an after-tax charge of about $17 million to pay its share of the Savings Association Insurance Fund. It said this could cause a "one-time charge to earnings, possibly as early as the third quarter" but didn't provide a per share estimate.

The change in SAIF law also could lead to a second, after-tax charge of as high as $65 million because the change could reduce the value of some of the company's franchises, Sovereign Vice President Mark McCollom said.
The second charge would also take place in the third quarter, McCollom said.
Sovereign, a $9.2 billion company with 122 banking offices in Pennsylvania, New Jersey and Delaware, said it would release third quarter results October 21.
